_comment: Kitsune collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed kitsune-foxfire` after Glacial's, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_kitsune.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Kitsune
readme.summary: Pokemon as fox spirits of shrine and legend, with kitsune mask markings and foxfire.
looks: each line wears one look: Inari's white shrine fox with vermilion markings (Riolu, Furfrou, Abra); kitsunebi, dark indigo haunted by drifting blue foxfire wisps (Gastly, Rotom, Tentacool); nogitsune, the wild black fox with gold markings and violet flames (Scraggy, Okidogi, Varoom); tenko, the celestial fox, pale gold fading to sky blue and dusted with stars (Shaymin, Castform, Flabebe); shrine, vermilion lacquer over black with a straw shimenawa rope and paper shide (Sudowoodo, Burmy, Lileep); autumn, russet fur scattered with maple leaves (Petilil, Shroomish, Yanma)
kitsune mask markings on the face; ears, tails and crests burn with foxfire that flickers in the dark; glowing eyes
shiny: the foxfire turned round the colour wheel
